basic_info.title: Deep Double Descent: Where Bigger Models and More Data Hurt

method.notes: Test error follows a double-descent curve in model size (and in training epochs): beyond the interpolation threshold, BIGGER models generalize better again. Practical import for this project: classical fear of overfitting is not a valid reason to keep the WM small — over-parameterization is typically benign in modern regimes; the realistic cost of a 2-5x wider model is wasted compute, not degraded accuracy.

gap_analysis.whats_missing: Not a map-matching paper; methodology reference for capacity-vs-overfitting reasoning.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Cited to reject the overfitting counter-argument against capacity probes P2/P3.
